_meta.phase: F0.5 Chunk C (tenant-aware Voice Test + function calling)
notes: GA migration (2026-05-07): session.type required = 'realtime' | 'transcription'. modalities REMOVED (audio+text auto). voice/transcription/turn_detection/format moved UNDER session.audio.{input,output}. temperature + max_response_output_tokens REMOVED at session level (per-response on response.create).
F0 legacy: tools field omitted (DefaultIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull). Instructions from appsettings.OpenAI.Instructions (generic Türkçe).
F0.5: VoicePocEndpoints overrides Instructions via InstructionsBuilder.Build(voiceContext) and attaches tools[0] = search_knowledge_base. CHANGES to either path require updating this contract.
F2 will add per-tenant overrides (tenant_settings.voice_realtime_overrides JSONB) + multi-tool catalog (transfer_to_human, voice_dtmf, collect_field).

session.instructions: [F0.5] InstructionsBuilder.Build → 'Sen {tenant_name} firmasinin ({sector}) sesli AI asistanisin. Aktif konusma akisi: {flow_name}. ...' (deterministic from VoiceTestContext). [F0 legacy] appsettings.OpenAI.Instructions generic Türkçe.

tools.name: search_knowledge_base
tools.description: Search the active tenant's knowledge base (FAQs + documents) for the user's question. Use whenever the customer asks about specific information you do not already know with certainty (e.g. pricing, working hours, procedure details, appointment policy, address). Returns top results with scores; if results is empty, follow the included Turkish guidance.

query.description: The customer question in natural Turkish (e.g. 'saç ekimi sonrası ne kadar dinlenmek gerekir?'). Do NOT translate to English.

top_k.description: How many results to return (default 3). Server-side clamped to [1,10].

_endpoints._ga_header_notes: OpenAI-Beta: realtime=v1 REMOVED on 2026-05-07 GA migration. Authorization Bearer is the only required header now.

_notes: F0.5 Chunk C. Model emits args incrementally via .delta then a final .done with the complete args + name.
VoiceRuntime ToolExecutor buffers per call_id (AD-31 ConcurrentDictionary defense), executes under 5sn timeout, replies with conversation.item.create function_call_output + response.create.

error_handling.unknown_tool_name: ToolExecutor returns INV-VR-023 structured error JSON → model speaks Turkish fallback. Session continues.
error_handling.args_parse_failed: INV-VR-016 → 'Arac argumanlari JSON formatinda degil.' → fallback.
error_handling.execute_timeout_5s: INV-VR-017 'kb_unavailable' shape → model speaks 'şu an bilgi bankama ulaşamıyorum'.
error_handling.kb_http_error: INV-VR-017 same kb_unavailable shape via KnowledgeSearchException.

_turn_detection_decision_log.rationale: AD-12: F0 tests OpenAI's native semantic EOT in real Turkish conversation. If accuracy < ~85% on hesitation scenarios, F2 will layer pipecat-ai/smart-turn-v2 ONNX on top of Silero VAD.

alternatives_considered.rejected_because: client-side endpointing not implemented in F0 (Silero VAD instruments but does not gate turn_detection)
